title: Christmas markets by train with kids
hook: Three Christmas markets, two easy trains
dates: 7 days, any week Nov 26 to Dec 13, 2026 (sample: Thu Dec 3 to Wed Dec 9)
who: Families with kids about 4 to 12 (notes for little ones and teens); fly into Vienna, home from Munich

days.title: Vienna: land, then the Rathaus lights

stops.name: Land at Vienna Airport
stops.why: Railjet or Intercity to the main station: 15 min

stops.name: Check in: Hotel Rathauspark
stops.why: 575 steps from City Hall and the market
stops.kid_note: Listed by the hotel as family friendly.

stops.name: Wiener Christkindlmarkt, Rathausplatz
stops.why: Stalls in front of City Hall, daily 10 AM to 10 PM
stops.kid_note: Kids' Christmas world in the park: double-decker carousel, reindeer train, Ferris wheel.
stops.booking_note: Nov 13 to Dec 26. Trams 1, 71, D or U2 (Rathaus).

days.title: Vienna: palace market, kids' rink, schnitzel

stops.name: Schönbrunn Palace Christmas Market
stops.why: Stalls in the palace forecourt, daily 10 AM to 9 PM
stops.kid_note: Free Glice rink for kids, plus a carousel, Ferris wheel and kids' railway.

stops.name: Kids' ice rink, Rathauspark
stops.why: A 110 m² kids' rink with skating-aid figures to hold
stops.kid_note: Free double-blade skates (sizes 21-25) and kids' helmets with a ticket.
stops.booking_note: Tickets online, at the ticket desks or machines. Rink open 10 AM to 10 PM.

stops.name: Figlmüller Wollzeile
stops.why: Wiener schnitzel on Wollzeile since 1905
stops.kid_note: Kitchen open until 9:30 PM, so an early table is easy.
stops.booking_note: Book ahead: +43 1 512 61 77. Open daily 11 AM to 10:30 PM.

legs.note: Plan with the Wiener Linien app.

stops.name: ÖBB Railjet, Vienna to Salzburg
stops.why: Two Railjets an hour; the fastest takes about 2 h 25 min
stops.kid_note: Ask for the family zone: last 2nd-class car (21 or 31), with a kids' cinema.
stops.booking_note: The family zone isn't on every train; the timetable detail shows which.

stops.name: Check in: Hotel Sacher Salzburg
stops.why: On the river, facing the Old Town and the fortress
stops.kid_note: Family suites; the Original Sacher-Torte downstairs.

stops.name: Salzburger Christkindlmarkt, Domplatz
stops.why: Stalls around the cathedral; Saturdays 9 AM to 9 PM

stops.name: Hellbrunner Adventzauber
stops.why: Palace Advent market with a kids' Christmas world
stops.kid_note: Weekends 11-6: Christmas train and petting zoo; scouts grill sausages at a campfire.
stops.booking_note: Bus 25 (toward Untersbergbahn) to Schloss Hellbrunn, about 25 min. Closed Mondays except Dec 21.

stops.name: Sternbräu
stops.why: Austrian cooking in an inn first named in 1542
stops.kid_note: Thirteen dining rooms and gardens under one roof.

legs.note: From the city center (Rathaus stop) or the main station (about 30 min).

stops.name: Train, Salzburg to Munich
stops.why: From about 1 h 40 min; check the timetable for works
stops.kid_note: Railjets have the same family zone.
stops.booking_note: Through Dec 12 the direct Railjet Xpress runs every 2 hours, about 15 min slower; extra ICE trains help.

stops.name: Check in: Platzl Hotel
stops.why: Old Town, a few minutes' walk from Marienplatz

stops.name: Münchner Christkindlmarkt, Marienplatz
stops.why: 138 stalls around Marienplatz; Mon to Sat 10 AM to 9 PM
stops.kid_note: The Kripperlmarkt by Alter Peter sells nativity figures down to tiny lanterns.
stops.booking_note: Nov 20 to Dec 24 (closed Nov 22). U3, U6 or S-Bahn to Marienplatz.

stops.name: St. Nicholas at the Residenz Christmas village
stops.why: The Nikolaus visits from 5 PM on Dec 6 and 7
stops.kid_note: He brings small gifts for kids while they last.
stops.booking_note: Free entry; enter from Residenzstraße at Odeonsplatz.

legs.note: Works through Dec 12: direct RJX every 2 h, about 15 min slower.

days.title: Munich: fairy tales and a kids' workshop

stops.name: Fairy-tale forest, Residenz Christmas village
stops.why: Press a button and Little Red Riding Hood comes alive
stops.kid_note: Under 6? Kasperle puppet theater here today, 3 to 4 PM, free.
stops.booking_note: Daily 11 AM to 9 PM, Nov 16 to Dec 22.

stops.name: Himmelswerkstatt kids' workshop
stops.why: Free Christmas crafts in City Hall for kids 6 to 12
stops.kid_note: Kids can dress up as angels while they make cards or candles.
stops.booking_note: Register with Kindermuseum München; sign-ups open 10 days ahead (Nov 28 for Dec 8). Meet at the Fischbrunnen, on time.

stops.name: Advent music from the Rathaus balcony
stops.why: Brass, choirs and folk music for about 30 minutes

stops.name: Weisses Bräuhaus
stops.why: Weisswurst breakfast, served 9 AM to noon only
stops.kid_note: Pretzels and sweet mustard; the sausages never hear the noon bells.

stops.name: S-Bahn to Munich Airport
stops.why: S1 or S8: about 40 min from the main station
stops.booking_note: Between them, a train every 10 minutes.

legs.duration: about 40 min from the main station

stays.name: Hotel Rathauspark
stays.why: 575 steps from the Rathausplatz market; family-friendly, redesigned in 2024.

stays.name: MEININGER Vienna Downtown Sissi
stays.why: Family rooms and cots, across the Danube Canal from the Old Town.

stays.name: Hotel Sacher Salzburg
stays.why: On the Salzach facing the Old Town; family suites and the Original Sacher-Torte.

stays.name: MEININGER Salzburg City Center
stays.why: Family rooms; the Old Town is about 25 minutes on foot.

stays.name: Platzl Hotel
stays.why: 4-star superior in the Old Town, a few minutes' walk from Marienplatz.

stays.name: MEININGER München Zentrum
stays.why: Family rooms, about a 15-minute walk from the main station.

heads_ups.text: Through Dec 12, construction in Germany thins the direct Railjet Xpress Vienna-Salzburg-Munich to every two hours, about 15 minutes slower. Extra ICE trains run.
Munich's free kids' workshop (Himmelswerkstatt, ages 6 to 12) needs registration, which opens 10 days before each date; it ends Dec 13.
Hellbrunn's famous trick fountains are closed until Mar 25, 2027. In Advent, go for the Advent market instead, which is closed Mondays (except Dec 21). Pony rides are gone.
Munich's market is closed Sunday Nov 22 and ends Dec 24 at 2 PM; the Residenz Christmas village ends Dec 22; Vienna's Rathausplatz market closes Dec 26.
